acceptanceCriteria: Each of the six alternatives is either delivered with tests or explicitly declined by the owner with the reason recorded in docs/specs/corvint-tasks-user-service-v0.md.
Main-controller restart debt is observed and charged, or its absence stays reported as NOT_OBSERVED.
Darwin helper support, if delivered, carries a descendant proof and its own platform evidence; nothing unrun is reported as passed.
body: The owner accepted V1-0804 (SERVICE500-007, PR #613) on 2026-10-05 with qualification NOT_RUN; platform qualification stays under V1-0697. Delivered as a Linux-only slice: per-helper manifest/unit/runtime identity, fenced foreground spawn with descendant verification before ACK, run-helper with bounded two-file rotating logs, helper restart debt with a resume journal, and install accepting helpers on Linux only. The orchestrator, under the owner's delegation, kept the fail-closed answers to the six build-log owner questions; the alternatives are tracked here: (1) held helper intent left by a killed wrapper recovers only by operator removal, no confirm verb or cgroup recovery; (2) no helper health signal, so helper debt resets only on a reconciled resume, not after 600s healthy; (3) status withholds the sanitized excerpt text; (4) the decision 0397 two-file internal/groupreap import edge is accepted as is; (5) Darwin helpers stay UNSUPPORTED until a descendant proof exists; (6) an interrupted resume retry is refused with REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT or RESOURCE_COLLISION rather than re-journalled. Also not delivered: main-controller restart debt (NOT_OBSERVED, not charged), Pdeathsig, and closing the helper-executable hash TOCTOU window. NOT_RUN: make gate and tests outside the focused set. See docs/build-log/2026-10-05-v1-0804-service-helpers.md.
title: Service helpers: Darwin support, helper health reset, held-intent recovery and main restart debt (V1-0804 follow-up)
